title: HubEndpointPolicy v1
description: Trusted deployment policy authorizing exactly one Hub base URL/origin for the WAIKE client. Launch-context hub_url may request a Hub; this policy is the authorization authority.

authorized_hub_base_url.description: Normalized Hub base URL (scheme://host[:port][/path]); trailing slash optional; must parse under Hub URL rules.

deployment_id.description: Deployment or site identifier for this authorization.

site_id.description: Optional school/community site id (may match login site_id).

require_https.description: When true, remote Hub must be https unless allow_insecure_local explicitly permits a matching http URL.

allow_insecure_local.description: Explicit local/test exception allowing the authorized http Hub (Device Lab). Never implied by launch context alone.

expires_at.description: Optional RFC3339 expiry; null/omitted means no expiry.
